latest_cos_commentary.headline: Punchh now ties loyalty to identity resolution across non-loyalty transactions.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Punchh now ties loyalty to identity resolution across non-loyalty transactions.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: PAR launched Guest360 alongside Punchh September 1; select customers were live and broader rollout was planned through 2026. Second check: PAR cited Smoothie King results in the first three months of PAR Games within Punchh.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Probe guest recognition accuracy, incremental revenue and data portability at named enterprise accounts.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Select live customers and planned rollout do not prove availability across every Punchh customer. Vendor-reported customer outcomes should be validated against baseline, denominator and control.
